worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.summary: A bramble shield bursts up around you, blocking enemy attacks by a total pool and shaking off status moves aimed at you; every contact attack it blocks pricks the attacker, once per attacker per shield.
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.descriptio: A thorned shield bursts up around you: it lasts %1$s ticks and fully blocks up to %2$s points of damage from enemies; when the pool is spent the shield falls, and damage beyond the remaining pool still reaches you.
Repeated bramble shields in quick succession are more likely to fail; the current failure chance is %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.use.0: Bait a melee foe onto the thorns
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.use.1: Block a volley while pricking the melee charging in
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.use.2: Seal off a status move before it lands
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.preference: On (sharp): thorn damage x1.25, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85, recover 5 ticks. Off (thick): pool x1.25, duration x1.15, but thorn x0.8, recover 8 ticks.
Raise once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
world_combat.move.spikyshield.text.ward: The bramble shook off the status move
worldcombat.skill.spikyshield.descriptio: Damage you deal to yourself, and environmental damage with no enemy behind it, do not consume the shield.

Every contact attack the shield blocks pricks its attacker for about %1$s physical damage (the attacker's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on the hit); each attacker is pricked only once per shield.
While the shield holds, status moves that enemies aim at you are shaken off before they can take effect.
